verses.1: For the divisions of the tribes, for the inheritance of the land from Caleb, son of Jephunet, among the sons of Esau.
verses.2: And to Meshlemiah’s sons: Zekaryah, Yediyael, Shenei, and Yatniel.
verses.3: The fifth in rank: Yehohanan the Sixth, Eliehuayni the Seventh.
verses.4: And to serve Adam’s children: Shemaya, Bechor, Yehozabad, Sheni, Yoach, Shlizi, and Shachar HaRaviv. And then Natanel HaHamini.
verses.5: Amiel the Seventh, Ishashkar the Eighth; my eighth act, for God has blessed him.
verses.6: And Lismaiah, our son, was born to sons who belong to their father’s family. They are like those noble warriors who rule over their lands.
verses.7: The sons of Shemaiah were Atni, Rephael, and Oved Elzavad. Their brothers were Beni-Chayil Elihu and Semkya.
verses.8: All these are the descendants of Adam’s servants. Their children and brothers are men who can be used to serve Adam. There are sixty-two such people who can serve Adam.
verses.9: And Lemeshiah had sons and brothers. Their number was about ten.
verses.10: And from the sons of Merari, he took male descendants as priests. They were not to be put to death; their father placed them in positions of authority.
verses.11: The second part: Tabliyahu, the third part: Zekhariyahu. All sons and brothers are to be blessed; three dozen in total.
verses.12: To these servants, the doors of the chambers were assigned by the rulers, so that they could serve in the house of Jehovah.
verses.13: And they laid their bones in small and large piles, in the houses of their ancestors, at every door and corner.
verses.14: And the golem fell from the east towards Salem and Zekhariah. His son, Yo’eish, warned them with his wisdom. Then the golem went northward.
verses.15: To serve Adam, Negeb and his descendants were given the house of Asupim.
verses.16: For protection and safety from harm, with a door that opens at the top of the structure. It serves as a safeguard for protection purposes.
verses.17: To the eastern side of the land, six days in total for the journey to the day of Arba’ah. And two days for those who are going there.
verses.18: For the four days of mourning, two days of fasting.
verses.19: These are the parts of the ovaries that are used to form eggs and other reproductive cells.
verses.20: And let the people rejoice over the treasures of the house of God and over the sacred treasures.
verses.21: The sons of Ladan, the sons of Gershunni, for Ladan. The heads of the fathers for Ladan, the sons of Gershunni, Yehiyali.
verses.22: The sons of Jechieli were Zetham and Yoel, his brothers. They were the ones who inherited the property of the house of Jehovah.
verses.23: To my beloved friends, to those who are dear to me, to Aziyeli.
verses.24: And Shebuel, son of Gershom, son of Moses, shall speak about the treasures.
verses.25: And their brothers were Eliezer, Rahabiah, his son; Ishaya, his son; Yoram, his son; and Zichri, his son. And Shlomo, their son.
verses.26: He and his brothers are responsible for all the sacred treasures that King David and the leaders of the fathers sanctified. These treasures include those belonging to the gods, the kings, and the priests.
verses.27: From the battles and from all kinds of hardships, he sanctified it to strengthen the house of Jehovah.
verses.28: And all those who are holy—Elah, Shaul son of Kish, Abner son of Ner, and Joab son of Tseruya. All of them were holy, under the leadership of Samuel and his brothers.
verses.29: For my purpose, I will make them and their children serve as officials and judges over Israel.
verses.30: To my servants and their brothers, the sons of Chail, one hundred and seventy thousand men, according to Israel’s commandment, from the Jordan River to the sea. All these men were chosen for serving the Lord and the king.
verses.31: To my friends, Yeriya the leader; to my children, to their fathers. In the fortyth year of King David’s reign, they were called upon to do so. And they found among them noble men who could be relied upon for assistance.
verses.32: And his brothers, the sons of Chilh, were one hundred and seventy. King David assigned them to oversee the livestock and all matters related to God’s commands.
